content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body:
Hello,

I hope you’re well. Before I sign, I’d like to suggest a couple of small adjustments to the agreement:

- The relevant clause currently allows additional services to be requested by EHS without a defined process. This could result in extra work that isn’t accounted for. Please change it to: “Provide such other services related to the foregoing only upon a written change order signed by both parties.”
- The relevant clause grants exclusive rights to all ingredients, product specifications, goodwill, and other intellectual property to EHS and EHN immediately, even though full payment and royalties are still pending. To ensure the rights are transferred only after compensation, please modify it to: “EHS and EHN shall obtain exclusive rights in and to all ingredients, product specifications, goodwill, and other intellectual property rights associated with any Product(s) only upon full payment of all fees and accrued royalties due to Dr. Murray.”

Thank you for considering these revisions. I look forward to moving ahead.

Best regards
